description: ALTER TABLE ... RENAME CONSTRAINT and ALTER/MODIFY CONSTRAINT enforcement properties (live-verified): rename moves the name, RELY/NORELY read back through SHOW UNIQUE KEYS' rely cell, ENFORCED/NOT ENFORCED accepted (no read surface), several properties in one statement, VALIDATE/NOVALIDATE refused as syntax errors despite the documentation, distinct not-there sentences for rename vs alter, and NORELY/ENFORCED staying usable as names. Converted 1:1 from ddl/AlterConstraintClausesTest (now retired).
